# Appalachian Outlaws Challenge - Week 2 Guide

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Apr 30, 2025
- 5 min read

Updated: May 17, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_62a15c9f12a34017bf176ce0cad777ed~mv2.png)

Image Credit:

With thanks to __Nerditbabe__, Trashy, XmasGoddess, and Shades451

The Appalachian Outlaws Challenge is a limited-time event in Fallout 76.

Running from the 22nd of April 2025 to the 6th of May 2025 at 12 PM US EST (at Atom Shop changeover), players can claim the Money Bag Backpack Skin for free from the Mini Seasons Board.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0329e976e51d4f839ddbd250c2b3af89~mv2.jpg)

To take part, head to an Armor Workbench and apply the Money Bag backpack skin to your backpack, then equip it. After that, complete the listed challenges to earn exclusive, limited-time rewards.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_02020dcd1b8946e3973e6ba7bc9560ad~mv2.png)

**Limited-Time Challenges have been reworked and are now called Mini Seasons**

**How it works:**

Complete each challenge to earn tickets, which can then be used to purchase the rewards from the limited-time reward board. This system works similarly to the current Season structure.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_46b62cd86bab466e9f5c372c4da80f92~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_957281b7cbfb4a3e9da3246e5b815cf2~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_f8df1308af8245bd8442568b3b710ce6~mv2.jpg)

__FAQ__

**Can we re-roll the challenges?**

No.

**Can I complete these challenges on a custom server?**

No.

**Can I complete these challenges on a private server, by myself, if I create a public team?**

Yes.

**Can I complete these challenges in one day?**

Yes, all the challenges for the week will likely be released on the first day, allowing you a week to complete them.

**Can I wear Power Armor while completing these challenges?**

**Yes!** — The challenge has been updated so that as long as you have the skin applied to a backpack and the backpack is equipped, it will count. This means you can now complete the challenge without exiting Power Armor or removing your helmet. *Things don't always go as planned, so maybe test it yourself first.

__Week 2 Challenges__

- Hack **3 Terminals** while wearing the Money Bag Backpack
- Collect **3 Cigar Boxes** while wearing the Money Bag Backpack
- Scrap Junk to get **5 Gold** while wearing the Money Bag Backpack
- Kill **50 Protectrons** while wearing the Money Bag Backpack
- Craft **760 Rounds of Ballistic Ammo** while wearing the Money Bag Backpack
- Consume **20 Alcoholic Drinks** while wearing the Money Bag Backpack
- Collect **76 Stimpaks or Chems** while wearing the Money Bag Backpack

If you want to complete the challenges without a start-to-finish guide, here are some tips to help you.

__Week 2__

**Challenge**

- Hack 3 Terminals while wearing the Money Bag Backpack. 
 - Where to find Locked Terminals in Fallout 76

**Challenge**

- Collect 3 Cigar Boxes while wearing the Money Bag Backpack. 
 - __Where to find Gold Junk in Fallout 76:__ I’ve noted any cigar box spawns that are easy to find at each location.
 - __Map of Spawn Locations__

**Challenge**

- Scrap junk to get 5 Gold while wearing the Money Bag Backpack. 
 - __Where to find Gold Junk in Fallout 76__
 - Chance to receive Gold Junk items as a reward for turning in Claim Tickets at Pleasant Valley Ski Resort
 - Purchase Gold Junk items from Helena in the Whitesprings Mall

**Challenge**

- Kill 50 Protectrons while wearing the Money Bag Backpack. 
 - Whitesprings Refuge - Pick a fight with the Robots, and plenty will spawn for you
 - Protectron Spawn Locations are at the bottom of this guide.
 - Check which "Kill a Robot with an X weapon" challenges you still need to complete—you might as well knock out two bots with one stone!

**Challenge**

- Craft 760 Ballistic Ammo while wearing the Money Bag Backpack. 
 - Equip the following perk cards before crafting: 
 - Super Duper
 - Ammosmith
 - Legendary Perk Card: Ammo Factory
 - Cheapest **Ballistic** Ammo to Craft (Rank 2 Ammosmith & Max Rank Ammo Factory):
 - Paddle Ball String 
 - x225 = 25 Cloth + 5 Rubber
 - Arrow 
 - x45 = 1 Adhesive + 1 Aluminum + 2 Plastic + 3 Steel
 - .50 Caliber Ball 
 - x22 = 5 Lead + 5 Steel
 - Railway Spikes 
 - x13 = 7 Steel

**Challenge**

- Consume 20 Alcoholic Drinks while wearing the Money Bag Backpack.
- __What counts towards Specific Challenges__
- Camp Resource: __Brewing Vat__
- I would suggest finding an __Addictol__ for this challenge as well
- Purchase from Whitespring Mall - Raider Vendor 
 - Easiest to Craft:
 - Fermentable Beer (no plan or wait time needed)
 - Super Duper Perk Card does not work on Alcohol
 - Perk Card: Green Thumb
 - Boiled Water x40 (Dirty Water x80)
 - Corn x20
 - Razorgrain x40
 - Wood x40
 - Fermentable Whiskey (no plan or wait time needed)
 - Super Duper Perk Card does not work on Alcohol
 - Perk Card: Green Thumb
 - Boiled Water x60 (Dirty Water x120)
 - Corn x60
 - Razorgrain x40
 - Wood x100
 - Fermentable Bourbon (no plan or wait time needed)
 - Super Duper Perk Card does not work on Alcohol
 - Perk Card: Green Thumb
 - Boiled Water x60 (Dirty Water x120)
 - Corn x60
 - Razorgrain x40
 - Wood x100

**Challenge**

- Collect 76 Stimpaks or Chems while wearing the Money Bag Backpack. 
 - All Stimpak variations count toward this challenge
 - Public and Non-Public Events reward Stimpaks
 - Pip-Boy Dailys reward Stimpaks
 - Pharma Farma Perk Card on First Aid Boxes
 - Raider Camp Collectron and Doctor's Orders Camp Resource
 - Crafting Stimpaks and Chems count towards this challenge (don't forget Super Duper Perk Card)
 - Purchase from Vendors and Medical Supplies Vending Machines
 - Easiest to Craft: 
 - Stimpak: Diluted (no plan needed)
 - Perk Cards: Chemist and Super Duper
 - Craft 5 at a time, so you don't use too many resources
 - Stimpak x38
 - Purified Water x76
